title: Illustration / People

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; visible default tab states

slide_intent: Represent people with recognizable proportions and varied identities so viewers can see themselves without being reduced to caricature.
strategic_value: A shared geometric anatomy with diverse bodies, cultures and skin tones can connect IBM’s engineered visual language with its stated human purpose.
demonstration: The webpage moves from illustrated workplace scenes through gridded anatomy and an eight-head skeleton to portraits, diverse figures and a Rose/Almond people palette.
practical_value: Construct a figure from the common skeleton, then select proportions, features and purposeful details that represent the intended person or community.

content_islands.name: Purpose and examples
content_islands.spec: Place the title and inclusion rationale above a montage of workplace, medical and individual scenes in flat and isometric treatments.

content_islands.name: Anatomy and skeleton
content_islands.spec: Follow gridded figures with the eight-head construction, joint diagrams and line-to-finished-figure progression examples.

content_islands.name: Portraiture
content_islands.spec: Place geometric front/profile heads above simplified portraits, followed by higher-fidelity portraits showing recognizable individuals.

content_islands.name: Diversity and inclusion
content_islands.spec: Continue with a group portrait and examples varying activity, clothing, ability, body shape and props.

content_islands.name: People palette
content_islands.spec: Close with Rose and Almond swatch columns and numeric values, keeping the skin/hair/nails-only explanation and palette download with them.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction connects inclusive representation to IBM’s global audience; the anatomy section explains that realistic simplification helps people recognize themselves.
reference_purposes.Expression: Figures share simplified geometry while varying bodies, skin tones, clothing, activities and portrait fidelity.
reference_purposes.Application: The page teaches eight-head-high construction, grid use, portrait refinement and purposeful selection of character details.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source rejects caricature and exaggerated expressions. Rose and Almond are reserved for skin, hair and nails and are not extensions of the main IBM palette.

ingredient.name: People palette
ingredient.role: Represent a range of people within the illustration system.
ingredient.application: Use the Rose and Almond scales for skin, hair and nails; choose character details with purpose and retain realistic proportions.
ingredient.scope: Specific to IBM people illustration. The page explicitly excludes these hues from general use as an expanded corporate palette.
